mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patrol_template (template_no, template_name, version, status, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{templateNo}, #{templateName}, #{version}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.template_no AS templateNo, t.template_name AS templateName, t.version, t.status, t.remark FROM patrol_template t JOIN (SELECT template_no, MAX(version) AS mv FROM patrol_template WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY template_no) x ON t.template_no = x.template_no AND t.version = x.mv WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.id
